title.en: Six tiers, from Leather to Netherite
title.zh-CN: 六种背包，从皮革到下界合金

caption.en: Sneak and right-click to set a backpack down anywhere; it keeps everything inside.
caption.zh-CN: 潜行右键就能把背包放在地上，里面的东西一样不少。

caption.en: Switch it on with Alt+Z and every drop nearby flies straight into the backpack on your back.
caption.zh-CN: 按 Alt+Z 打开，周围掉落的物品会直接飞进你背上的背包。

caption.en: A Diamond Backpack: 108 slots, five upgrades on the left, their tabs on the right, search and sort at the top.
caption.zh-CN: 钻石背包：108 格，左边五个升级，右边是它们的标签页，顶部有搜索和整理。

title.en: A crafting table in your backpack

caption.en: The Crafting Upgrade opens a 3×3 grid right next to your items.
caption.zh-CN: 合成升级在物品旁边打开一个 3×3 合成格。

caption.en: Eats from the backpack when you get hungry; choose which food it may use.
caption.zh-CN: 饿了会自动吃背包里的食物，还能指定吃哪些。

title.zh-CN: 按住 Shift 看看里面有什么

caption.en: Hold Shift over a backpack to see its upgrades and contents without opening it.
caption.zh-CN: 鼠标指着背包按住 Shift，不用打开也能看到升级和内容。

caption.en: Wear a backpack in the chest slot and press B to open it wherever you are.
caption.zh-CN: 把背包穿在胸甲栏，随时按 B 打开。

caption.en: Leather, string and a chest make your first backpack; every recipe is in the recipe book.
caption.zh-CN: 皮革、线和一个箱子就能做出第一个背包，所有配方都在配方书里。
